capabilities.notes: reference unit — full chain documented in findings 03-07
root code exec via IPK post-install script (rc.local otaTest hook absent on this build); telnet root shell; write-up pending, sharing privately (patch-risk concern); 48h agent campaign
identity gate {appid,md5,permissions}, all 12 contexts empty; validator = literal '../' substring test, no decode; robustness bugs: 1MB path crashes phoenix, sendPlatformMessage freezes renderer
pairing ported: client_id needs an APP-style MAC with colons (not the TV's); SSDP-impersonation MITM captures credentials (app validates CA chain, not pinning, no hostname check)
Community report: MQTT connected and traversal appeared closed; fileWrite, root, browser, protocol and build date unconfirmed; downgrade search unsuccessful.

First-hand 2026-11-04. Fingerprint: AirPlay `:7000/info` (unauthenticated bplist, any path) reports firmwareRevision 09.6022.260611 / firmwareBuildDate 2026-05-14; from the TV browser Hisense_GetFirmWareVersion() = V0000.09.60M.Q0611, Hisense_GetOSVersion() = U09.60, Hisense_GetChipSetName() = MTK9603, Hisense_GetModelName() = 58A51HUV_1000, Hisense_GetDeviceCode() = 000000. Bridge present (HiUtils_createRequest) but all 11 `../` fileRead probes return ret=false `invalid path:...` (../proc/uptime, ../websdk/Appinfo.json, ../var/local/otaTest.sh, FaaS package.json) - rejected at the API layer, not ENOENT. No 1883/9001/10001/16669 listeners; /function/basic/fetch/sw2 404s on 3366/3367, so the 09.60W FaaS-postinst route is not LAN-reachable on this build. 22/23/2323/8008 closed - never rooted. Pairing: modern profile accepted on the first attempt with an uppercase colon-separated TV_MAC (other MAC formats untested); PIN -> gettoken -> tokenissuance issued 2-day access / 30-day refresh.
Community report attributed to pavanjadhaw; public source pending. Pairing reported, but actions silent; traversal reported; write and root not confirmed.

capabilities.root: achieved (13 postinst runs as uid 0; no Dropbear on this build — boot persistence via the vendor service manager)
capabilities.notes: Pairing required the TV's real Wi-Fi MAC (a placeholder/random MAC is silently rejected at the MQTT layer; TLS completes but auth fails). self-install lane verified blocked: HiUtils fileWrite on websdk/Appinfo.json -> 503 'client request permission check error, please check appconfig' (fileRead ret=true returned {"AppInfo":[]}, unchanged after failed write). launcher end-to-end verified via Mac-side custom-app fallback + home-state transition broadcasts; gettvstate does NOT answer on this build (state stays null; only transition broadcasts + periodic sourcelist push), re-launching an identical custom app is deduped and needs a URL variant (?v=2). fileRead is a strict /APPS/ path joiner (no escape found). Bridge surface from a plain http page: 108 platform names on window, 85 Hisense_Get* callable; GetDeviceCode masked '000000' in page scope; getter error paths accept injected text -> read/oracle primitive only, no write privilege. Root: the browser file bridge stayed closed; the write primitive is the FaaS fetcher (basic/fetcher fetchFile, uid 314), which is a different surface from file_bridge_write. 'Architecture: mtk9603' read from the device's own opkg.conf, not from model docs; opkg status DB at /APPS/pkgs/opkgmeta/status. Persistence: a two-file service in an already-rw vendor package plus one serviceList.json entry, run by the vendor service manager at every boot as uid 314 (proven across a power-cycle). Model guide: docs/models/43Q60SEVS/V0000.09.60W.Q0612/.
